rows.en: THANK YOU FOR COMING, DOCTOR SAHARA…
One-Seven… how did you get into a place like this?
THIS PASSAGE CONNECTS TO THE SEA.
Father… from the sea, he could get in without anyone noticing, couldn't he?
Hmm… So, what do you need me for?
I WANT YOU TO REMOVE ONE-EIGHT'S SATURN CIRCUIT…
Saturn Circuit?
It's a device that makes him obey only Brain's orders!
Brain's…?
All right, let's give it a try…
Defeat Haken Killer!
Defeat all Brain robots and Kelbaans!
Defeat all Brain robots, Kelbaans and Gigants!
One-Eight is defeated…?
Saburo Minami or One-Seven is defeated
This is not good…
What do the stars foretell?
Mars is in retrograde and about to enter Scorpio.
Mars in retrograde? Into Scorpio?

According to the teachings of ancient Babylon, when Mars goes retrograde and enters Scorpio, an emperor must take care…

You must not leave the palace.
I am the Fuhrer of the Black Cross Army! Do you think I'd lose my nerve over some horoscope!?

No… Even you, Your Excellency, cannot defy fate!

Until a fortunate constellation comes around… please, I beg you, refrain from rash action…

Silence! Defying fate and forcing it to bend is also the power of an emperor!

Very well… Throw down a challenge to the Gorengers! I'll face them myself!

The best way to defeat the Gorengers is to uncover their secret base and launch a surprise attack!

Please leave it to me…

Wait!

I have no taste for cheap tactics like surprise attacks! I'll crush them head-on with force!
No, but… even according to Lord Apfaron's divination, Mars has already entered Scorpio…
Are you saying you won't obey my orders!? Throw down the challenge!!
"With this… either the Gorengers or the Black Cross Army… one of them will vanish, it seems."
The Gorengers and the Black Cross Fuhrer were finally going to face off!!
Black Cross Fuhrer, come out!!
Are you ready? Gorengers!!
Wait! Wait! Your Excellency, please…
Here I come!
The time has come to settle this, hasn't it? Black Cross Fuhrer!
I've ordered my men not to interfere… This fight will last until one of us is dead! Agreed?
Bring it on!
Now, come! Gorengers!
Toyah…!
Torya…!
Hah hah hah… That doesn't hurt one bit!
Then how about this?
Toyah!
What's that supposed to be!
Here comes the great Kirenger's attack!
Hmph…!
Uwaaaagh! Ow, ow, ow…
Didn't work at all, did it…
What? Done already?
We can't lay a finger on him!
Damn you…
He's invincible…
That's the Black Cross Fuhrer for you…
Is he a monster!?
Hah hah hah… Is that the best you've got?
Kuh…

I am immortal! No weapon or ammunition on this Earth can defeat me!

I've seen your little act! Now it's my turn to show you mine… Black Cross Spark!

Pathetic fools…

Did you see that, Apfaron? Even the Gorengers are as easy as twisting a baby's arm!
Yes… As expected of Your Excellency! Splendid…
Now, the finishing blow! Black Cross Sword!

…!?

Gwaaaaagh…! Th-the pain… Everyone, I'm in paaain!!
Cassiopeia…?
Cassiopeia?

What are you doing!?

Bring the shelter, quickly!
Hoi!
Get His Excellency to the shelter, quickly…
Ugh… Careful! Carry me slowly, slowly… Ugh, ugh…
Your Excellency! I, Golden Mask, am prepared to throw away my life!
You'll burn your life away…?
Yes, sir…
I'm counting… on you…
Take him away, quickly!
Wait! Black Cross Fuhrer! This fight isn't over yet!
His Excellency is in no condition to fight! I'll be your opponent! Here I come!!
"The battle seems to be turning against us…"
Momo! Gorenger Storm New Power Operation!
Nuoooooh…!! Golden Mask never dies… he only fades away!
Great General? More like Lousy General!?
You said it…

…!?

This gold dust… it just won't come off.
That can't be all Golden Mask has got.

uncertain: U14434: defeat condition ends with '…？' in the source; kept the question mark.
U14438-U14446: astrology terms: 逆行 'retrograde', サソリ座 'Scorpio'.
U14476: お前たちの芫 read as 芸 ('your little act').
U14481/U14482: カシオペア kept as 'Cassiopeia' (constellation reference in Apfaron's reading).
U14496: parody of 'Old soldiers never die, they just fade away' (散りゆく read for 敬りゆく).
U14495: [ja] rendered 'Gorenger Storm New Power Operation' (glossary: Gorenger Storm).

new_names.why: short form of Golden Mask Great General
